protection.subtitle: What Vigil has caught for you, from the local audit ledger (same data as `vigil-hub inspect protection`).
protection.secrets_blocked_hint: Raw secrets denied before reaching the server or model.
protection.leaks_detected_hint: Secrets found in tool output; redacted before the agent when result redaction is on.
protection.aliases_withheld_hint: secret:// placeholders that did not resolve, so the call was denied.
protection.events_audited_hint: Across {sessions} session(s) — Vigil is recording activity.
protection.chain_ok_body: The audit log has not been tampered with — the tamper-evident hash chain verifies.
protection.chain_bad_body: The audit log failed hash-chain verification (possible tampering). Recent details are hidden for safety.
protection.recent_empty: No protection events yet. Route your MCP tools through Vigil and use your agent normally — Vigil records and redacts as they run.
protection.recent_suppressed: Recent details are hidden because the audit chain failed verification (a tampered log could contain injected secrets).
protection.loading_failed: Could not load the protection summary.

hero.subtitle: {agents} connected · all eight defense layers online
hero.subtitle_none: No AI agent connected yet — click Deploy Guardian to turn on protection

guardian.title: Guardian (Aegis)
guardian.subtitle: One click and your AI agents are guarded. Aegis pins the protection to a stable path that survives app updates.
guardian.hub_missing: vigil-hub engine not found — reinstalling the app fixes this; or place the vigil-hub executable next to the app / on PATH.
guardian.pending_trust_hint: Codex requires a one-time review before it runs any user hook: open codex, type /hooks, and trust the Vigil entries. Until then codex will not run the protection.

browser_guard.title: Browser Guard
browser_guard.subtitle: Paste, input and submit on guarded AI sites are checked locally by the native host — secrets are redacted or blocked before they reach the page.
browser_guard.register_hint: Register from the browser extension's options page — copy the vigil-native-host install command there (it embeds your extension ID).

engine.missing_body: The Vigil engine (vigil-hub) isn't on this machine — protection is unavailable. One click below downloads the full engine (ML variant) securely: signed manifest + SHA-verified over HTTPS.

engine.title: AI Engine & Model
engine.subtitle: Choose the privacy / injection engine. Hard-fingerprint is always on; the AI model adds wider coverage and needs the model installed.
engine.mode_hardfp_desc: Deterministic regex redaction only (default). Offline, no model, <1ms.
engine.mode_ml_desc: DeBERTa / PII model for wider coverage. ~+0.3–0.6s per guarded call; requires the model.
engine.mode_auto_desc: Use the AI model if installed, else fall back to hard-fingerprint. Never fails to start for a missing model.

model.title: AI Model
model.subtitle: Local privacy models (DeBERTa injection + PII, ~738MB each). Secure first-run download (HTTPS + SHA-verified).

posture.title: Security Posture
posture.subtitle: Controls placeholder × native-tool handling; raw secrets are always blocked at any level (hard floor).

daemon.title: Daemon (resident engine)
daemon.subtitle: A resident daemon holds the warm AI model so the hook main path runs ML with zero cold-start. Start it to enable ML protection for your agent.
daemon.subtitle_no_model: No AI model installed yet: starting now runs model-less (the hook stays on the hard-fingerprint floor). Install the AI model above first so the daemon can warm ML protection.

checkpoint.title: Audit checkpoint anchor
checkpoint.note: Append the current chain head to the local checkpoint sidecar - a later verify can prove this prefix was not rewritten.

about.note: Vigils Desktop · local AI control plane.

approval.empty_extra: Risky tool calls awaiting human review will appear here.
approval.scope_modal_hint_single: Dispatcher requires a scope for every Approve action. The selected scope applies to this approval.
approval.scope_modal_hint_bulk: Dispatcher requires a scope for every Approve action. The selected scope applies to the {count} selected approvals.
approval.scope_once_desc: Only this invocation passes; consumed on use
approval.scope_this_session_desc: Auto-pass subsequent calls in the same session matching (server_id, tool_name, args_hash)
approval.confirm_deny_content:
This action is written to the audit ledger and cannot be undone.
Approval ID: {id}
approval.bulk_approve_confirm_content:
Each item is written independently to the audit ledger (per-event hash chain). Cannot be undone.
Scope: {scope}
approval.bulk_deny_confirm_content: Each item is written independently to the audit ledger (per-event hash chain). Cannot be undone.

activity.search_placeholder: FTS5 query — e.g. "token" / task AND approved / prefix*
activity.empty_hits_extra: Try different keywords or clear search.
activity.empty_events_extra: Connect an AI agent (Claude Code / Cursor / Zed) to start logging events.

session.empty_sessions_extra: Connect an AI agent (e.g. Claude Code / Cursor) to start logging sessions.
session.badge_not_verified_detail: replay invoked with verify=false — ledger-wide chain not checked

privacy.hero_subtitle: Metadata only — labels / counts / fingerprints; raw text is never stored
privacy.page_subtitle_1: Sensitive hits intercepted by Vigil across firewall preflight, extension paste, and credential scans.
privacy.page_subtitle_2: — this panel shows only label / count / fingerprint metadata.
privacy.by_label_empty: No PII hits yet (or firewall preflight hasn't run)

server.empty_servers_extra: Add an MCP server via vigil-hub add-remote-mcp or local stdio to see it here.
server.servers_register_cta: Run `vigil-hub setup --all` to bring your agents' MCP servers under the gateway (or wrap one manually with `vigil-hub wrap`) — they appear here once registered.
server.confirm_approve_drift_body: Accept the new descriptor_hash={new_hash} for tool `{tool}` (old {old_hash}).
server.confirm_reject_drift_body: Reject the new descriptor for tool `{tool}` and restore the old hash={hash}.

detail.privacy_findings_note: PII / credential types and counts intercepted by Vigil in this session; raw text is never persisted.
detail.effect_raw_summary: Raw JSON (transparency note — click to expand)
detail.resolved_note: This request is resolved — resolution details require a separate query (coming in later α).

shortcuts.footnote: Press ? anytime to toggle this help. Shortcuts are disabled while typing in an input.
shortcuts.open_drawer: Open detail drawer for selected row

onboardingCard.drift_alert_body: This server's launch argv has drifted; the new hash awaits approval. The runner spawn path is fail-closed.
onboardingCard.env_keys_pending: Awaiting lease analysis (I06) — visible after first spawn
onboardingCard.confirm_approve_content: Server {serverId}'s argv will be accepted as new hash {hash}. The decision is recorded as an audit event.
onboardingCard.confirm_reject_content: Reject the new argv and restore old hash {hash}. The next spawn stays blocked until accepted or cleared.
